author: Wahiz
body:
Only hopped on to post this "parody" of the Christmas Carol "Twas The Night Before Christmas"

I hope you all have a Merry Christmas & A Happy New Year!!

Twas the night before AviMas, and all through the server.

Not a player was stirring, not even a mouse.

The stockings were hung, by the forums with care, in hopes AviClaus soon will be there!

The players were nestled, all snug in their beds.

While visions of hackers, cheated in their heads.

And {tag=0b8f95fa0f404f289fd0b8e243bb6800} in her kerchief, and {tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46} in his cap.

Had just settled their brains for a long winters nap.

When out on the server arose such a clatter!

{tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46} sprang from his bed to see what's the matter.

Away to the server he flew like the flash, tore open the server and threw up his sash.

The moon on the breasts of the new fallen snow.

Gave a luster of mid-day hackers below. When what to his wondering eyes should appear.

But a minature sleigh,  and 8 tiny moderators. 

With a little old driver, so 'hacky' and so quick, he knew in a moment it must be Sheep_Ship!

More rapid then Eagles, his coursers came, he whistled and shouted and called them by name!

Now {tag=6248019ce74a42a4bf4b9cf1c189a72d} , now {tag=2d6f79100ad94d87b5285beb41c150ce}! Now, {tag=99b8a2a4cb224ba1a6837cd90a02aac5}, and  {tag=bf3319534f9243ee8abc7544b8234936}

On {tag=0c20aa0d82f946cdaeae29cf1f112aa2}, On {tag=24339469129f4eeba474ed8f2934b300}, On {tag=1c898c77b0cc474a8ce4b5521f2b18e7}, and {tag=38cc237d92724e01ad24f5b0110130c1}

On top of the server, and on top of the forums!

Now, Ban Away! Ban Away! Ban Away All!

(Got tired, so didn't continue after this, and again.Merry Christmas)
